messages.content: What's the current traffic condition in New York?

function.name: geocode_address

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live traffic feeds, so I can’t tell you the current traffic conditions in New York right now. I can, however, share some general information about typical traffic patterns in the city—just let me know if that would be helpful!

We can say we don't have real-time data. We can offer to provide typical traffic patterns. That is safe.

We can also use geocode_address to get coordinates of New York. But that doesn't answer traffic. We can call geocode_address with address "New York" to get coordinates.
